name: My Fairy Tales -Meet the Prince Charming-
source:
The story begins with you working hard every day to become a great magician. One day, you accidently find a strange door at your grandmother’s house; curious to find out what’s behind the door, you enter…

But now, there’s just one problem; you find yourself unable to leave. In order to get back where you came from, you learn you must fulfill a requirement -  you need to make someone happy in this world.　
Here comes the chance to make your own fantasy fairy tale in this retelling of two classic stories. Will you live happily ever after?

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/71155701161/shall-we-date-my-fairy-tales-release-date]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
故事從你每天努力成為偉大魔法師開始。某天，你在祖母家意外發現一扇奇怪的門；出於好奇，你走了進去……

但現在有個問題：你發現自己無法離開。為了回到原來的世界，你必須滿足一個條件——讓這個世界的某個人獲得幸福。

在這個重述兩則經典故事的作品中，你有機會創造屬於自己的夢幻童話。你能從此幸福地生活下去嗎？
